privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introBody: IMC ("the Company") establishes this Privacy Policy ("this Policy") regarding the handling of users' personal information and other data collected in connection with the service "Creepy Hub" ("the Service") provided by the Company, in compliance with the Act on the Protection of Personal Information and other related laws and guidelines.
privacy.collectBody:
This Policy applies to all relationships between the Company and users regarding the handling of personal information and other data in the Service.

The Company may collect the following information ("Personal Data") in connection with providing the Service:

  • Email address, username, and other information for user identification
  • Content posted, sent, or uploaded by users (including text, images, and all other information)
  • Usage history, access logs, IP addresses, device information, browser information, and other communication-related data
  • Reports, inquiries, rights infringement claims, and other information provided by users or third parties
  • Information obtained through integration with external services (limited to cases where the user has permitted such integration)
  • Other information the Company deems necessary for providing, maintaining, and improving the Service
privacy.useBody:
The Company shall use the collected Personal Data within the scope of the following purposes:

  • Provision, maintenance, operation, and quality improvement of the Service
  • User identity verification, authentication, and account management
  • Prevention of unauthorized use, security measures, and response to violations
  • Response to reports, rights infringement claims, and dispute prevention and resolution
  • Improvement of the Service, usage analysis, and development of new features
  • Display, distribution, translation, editing, processing, and use of posted content in external services
  • Response to user inquiries, consultations, and support
privacy.thirdPartyBody:
The Company shall not provide personal information to third parties without prior user consent, except as permitted by law.

The Company uses the following external services for providing, operating, and implementing features of the Service:

  • Google OAuth (Authentication): Used for login via Google accounts.
  • Discord OAuth (Authentication): Used for login via Discord accounts.
  • Google Translate API (Translation): Used for translating posted content to English.
  • Supabase: Used for storing authentication data and posts.
  • Resend: Used for sending authentication and password reset emails.
  • Other external services the Company deems necessary

Data may be stored or processed on servers managed by external service providers, which may be located outside of Japan. Users agree to this in advance.

Please refer to each service's official website for their respective privacy policies.
privacy.localStorageBody:
The Company may use cookies, local storage, and similar technologies ("Cookies, etc.") for the purpose of improving convenience, analyzing usage, improving service quality, and preventing unauthorized use.

We use your browser's local storage for the following purposes:

  • Temporarily saving drafts of posts and files
  • Recording storage consent status

This data is stored only in your browser and is never sent to our servers.

Users may refuse or delete Cookies, etc. through browser settings, but some features of the Service may become unavailable.
privacy.securityBody:
The Company shall implement organizational, human, physical, and technical security measures to prevent leakage, loss, damage, unauthorized access, and other risks to Personal Data.

We implement appropriate security measures including enforced HTTPS, Content Security Policy (CSP) headers, input validation, rate limiting, and login attempt restrictions.
privacy.changesBody:
The Company may change this Policy as necessary due to changes in laws, changes in Service content, or other needs.

When changing this Policy, the Company shall notify users of the revised content and its effective date by posting on the Service or other methods the Company deems appropriate.

Users who continue to use the Service after the effective date of the revised Policy shall be deemed to have consented to the changes.
privacy.contactBody:
Inquiries regarding this Policy, complaints about the handling of personal information, consultations, requests for disclosure, and all other communications shall be accepted at the following contact:

Operator: IMC
Email: inakurokaisyuubu@gmail.com

For more details, please visit our Contact page.

childSafety.metaDescription: creepy.hub Child Sexual Abuse and Exploitation (CSAE) prevention standards and reporting channels — IMC
childSafety.title: Child Safety Standards (CSAE)
childSafety.introBody:
IMC ("the Company") operates the service "Creepy Hub" (the "Service") and treats child safety as a top priority. We do not tolerate any content or behavior that constitutes Child Sexual Abuse and Exploitation ("CSAE") under any circumstances, including fictional or creative contexts.

These standards comply with Google Play's Child Safety Standards Policy, Japan's Act on Regulation and Punishment of Acts Relating to Child Prostitution and Child Pornography (the "Anti-Child Pornography Act"), the Child Welfare Act, and other applicable laws.
childSafety.prohibitedBody:
The following content and conduct are strictly prohibited on the Service in any context, including fiction and creative works:

  • Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) or content that may constitute CSAM
  • Sexualized, suggestive, or exploitative depictions of persons under 18 (or persons reasonably perceivable as under 18)
  • Grooming, solicitation, or other exploitation of minors for sexual purposes
  • Use of real children's photos, videos, or audio in sexual contexts
  • Content that endorses, promotes, or normalizes child sexual exploitation, including under the guise of fiction or creative works
  • Content that promotes physical or psychological harm to children, or that may induce imitation
childSafety.reportingBody:
Users and third parties may report any CSAE-related content or conduct on the Service through any of the following channels at any time:

  • The in-app reporting function attached to each post and comment
  • Dedicated email: info@creepyhub.com
  • Contact page: /en/contact

Please include as much detail as possible (target URL, username, situation description). Anonymous reports are accepted. We strictly protect reporter information and prioritize reporter safety.
childSafety.responseBody:
Upon receiving a report concerning CSAE or potential CSAE, we will:

  • Conduct an initial review within 24 hours as a general rule.
  • Immediately make non-public or remove content reasonably likely to constitute CSAE, without waiting for full investigation results.
  • Suspend the violator's account immediately and, if necessary, impose a permanent ban (including prohibition of re-registration).
  • Preserve relevant communication logs, IP addresses, and device information within the retention periods required by law.
  • Maintain the ability to explain our CSAE response practices at any time.

We will continuously implement reasonable measures in the design and operation of the Service to ensure child safety.
childSafety.lawEnforcementBody:
When we identify CSAE content, we cooperate with the following authorities and organizations:

  • National Police Agency of Japan and prefectural police (in cases of urgency)
  • Internet Hotline Center Japan (IHC): https://www.internethotline.jp/
  • Safer Internet Association (SIA)
  • For cross-border cases, coordination with international child protection organizations including reporting to the U.S. National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC)

We will provide necessary information to authorities upon receiving lawful disclosure requests, investigation inquiries, or other legitimate requests.
childSafety.complianceBody:
These standards comply with the following laws and policies:

  • Act on Regulation and Punishment of Acts Relating to Child Prostitution and Child Pornography (Japan)
  • Child Welfare Act (Japan)
  • Act on the Protection of Personal Information (Japan)
  • Google Play Developer Program Policies (Child Safety Standards)
  • Apple App Store Review Guideline 1.1.1 (Objectionable Content)
  • Other applicable domestic laws and international conventions
childSafety.contactBody:
Inquiries, reports, and requests for explanation regarding these standards and our CSAE response shall be accepted at the following contact. Through this channel, we maintain the ability to explain our CSAM prevention measures and compliance at any time.

Translation results are merely supplementary displays of the original text; the original text shall prevail in interpretation.

Users agree in advance that Posted Content may be sent to external services for translation processing.

Article 9 (Prohibited Actions)

Users shall not engage in any of the following actions when using the Service:

Notwithstanding the above, horror content expressions are permitted within the scope of fiction.

However, users shall not post horror content that:

  • Specifically promotes or may incite imitation of real-world illegal or dangerous acts

  1. Your name or organization name and contact information (email, phone number, etc.)

Filing false or fraudulent claims may result in account suspension or other measures.
